==Standard dialogue==
* '''Martin Thwait:''' You know it's sometimes funny how things work out, I lose some gold but find an item, or I lose an item and find some gold... no-one ever knows what's gone where ya know.
* {{topt|Yeah I know what you mean, found anything recently?}}
** {{tcond|If the player doesn't have at least level 50 Thieving:}}
*** '''Martin Thwait:''' Sorry, mate. Train up your Thieving skill to at least 50 and I might be able to help you out.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tcond|If the player has between level 50-98 Thieving, but doesn't have at least level 50 Agility:}}
*** '''Martin Thwait:''' Sorry, mate. Train up your Agility skill to at least 50 and I might be able to help you out.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tcond|If the player has over level 50 Thieving and Agility, or level 99 Thieving outright:}}
*** {{tact|opens=Martin Thwait's Lost and Found.}}
* {{topt|Can you tell me about your cape?}}
** '''Player:''' Can you tell me about your cape?
** '''Martin Thwait:''' Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
** '''Martin Thwait:''' The Cape of Thieving provides a nice boost to your chances of pickpocketing when worn. Is there anything else I can help you with?
** {{topt|Have you found anything recently?}}
*** {{tact|above}}
** {{topt|No thank you.}}
*** '''Player:''' No thank you.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Okay... I'll be going now.}}
** '''Player:''' Okay... I'll be going now.
** {{tact|end}}

==Treasure Trails==
* '''Martin Thwait:''' Ah! Here you go!
* '''Player:''' What?
* '''Martin Thwait:''' I need you to answer this for me.
* {{tbox|pic=Clue scroll (hard) detail.png|Martin has given you a challenge scroll!}}
* {{tact|end}}

====When spoken to again====
* '''Martin Thwait:''' Please enter the answer to the question.
* {{tcond|When given the wrong answer:}}
** '''Martin Thwait:''' How can that be? Go check again!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|When given the correct answer:}}
** '''Martin Thwait:''' Spot on!
** {{tcond|When given another clue scroll:}}
*** {{tbox|pic=Clue scroll (hard) detail.png|Martin has given you another clue scroll!}}
*** {{tact|receives=a clue scroll}}
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tcond|When given a reward casket:}}
*** {{tbox|pic=Reward casket (hard) detail.png|You've obtained a casket!}}
*** {{tact|receives=a reward casket}}
*** {{tact|end}}
